page_title: CEL 3-2 SEV | Celta Vigo v Sevilla 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' 3 - 2 Goal! 3:2. Kike Salas (Sevilla) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Kike Salas (Sevilla) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+1' 3 - 1 What a goal that is! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Orjan Nyland and into the net. 3:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

90' Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Vicente Guaita, who pulls off a stunning save! The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
89' Pablo Duran is being substituted because of an injury. Claudio Giraldez sends Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) on the pitch.
88' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
86' Sevilla keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
85' Joaquin Caparros Camino decides to make a substitution. Saul Niguez will be replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
83' Substitution. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) in, Hugo Alvarez out.
82' A player from Sevilla commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
82' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
76' Substitution. Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) on for Oscar Mingueza.
73' Pablo Fuertes shows a yellow card to Isaac Romero (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
70' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Williot Swedberg is replaced by Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo).

68' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Pablo Fuertes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
67' Substitution. Peque makes his way off the pitch and Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) comes on as his replacement.
65' 2 - 1 Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball into the top right corner. What a special shot.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
63' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
55' Wasted opportunity! Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
53' Joaquin Caparros Camino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Suso (Sevilla) replacing Adria Pedrosa.
53' Peque (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Pablo Fuertes blows for a foul.
50' The corner from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by the defence.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes off for Javier Rodriguez.
46' Half-time substitution. Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) will not participate anymore and Fran Beltran is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+8' 1 - 1 Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) scores a goal! Once again, he proved that taking a penalty kick is not a big deal for him.
45+8' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is going to take the penalty!
45+7' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Sevilla!
45+6' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless challenge on his opponent and is shown a red card without any hesitation from the referee!

45+5' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sevilla players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Pablo Fuertes interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
45+5' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
45+1' It looks like Loic Bade may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Joaquin Caparros Camino replaces him with Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Loic Bade (Sevilla) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
42' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
40' Loic Bade (Sevilla) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

39' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
35' Sevilla take a short corner kick.
35' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Peque (Sevilla) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
33' Vicente Guaita makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) after a cross from the side.
31' A pass from Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by Orjan Nyland and the move breaks down.
25' Pablo Fuertes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
23' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' 1 - 0 Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
19' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Orjan Nyland is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
16' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Orjan Nyland intercepts the ball.
14' Ramon Martinez (Sevilla) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
14' The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.

13' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Vicente Guaita shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
12' Rough tackle by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
4' Dangerous play by Kike Salas (Sevilla). Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
3' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) prepares to take a corner kick.
3' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Celta Vigo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
Celta Vigo will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Pablo Fuertes.
